citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 11:47am on July 27,
2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee via phone call, voicemail, email, and waiting 30minutes. Licensee
called the inspector during this time and indicated she was at work and unavailable to assist with the inspection. Failure to
provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued
failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section

2.126(b) 
   
Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries. 
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 11:47am on July 27, 
2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee via phone call, voicemail, email, and waiting 30minutes. Licensee 
called the inspector during this time and indicated she was at work and unavailable to assist with the inspection. Failure to 
provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued 
failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action. 
 
 
End Section
